label: team_0060_nelke_02
text: As I’ve told you, the name’s Clive. Please don’t\nforget it.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_03
text: Glad to see you’ve got my name committed to\nmemory![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_04
text: Now, let’s pick up our conversation from where\nwe left off before.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_05
text: As I mentioned, I joined Operation Starfall to\nresolve a sticky situation and to find out the\r\nreasons behind Team Star’s odd behavior.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_06
text: Above all, I want to know why the students in\nTeam Star have stopped coming to school.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_07
text: And, just like Cassiopeia, I want the team to\ndisband for good.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_08
text: Since joining Operation Starfall with you, I’ve\nalready had some success in opening up a\r\ndialogue with Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_09
text: And I think I’m starting to understand things\nmore clearly.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_10
text: But I don’t have enough information just yet.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_11
text: That’s why I want to speak with students from\nTeam Star’s other squads as well.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0060_nelke_12
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]If you intend to take on another base, know that
you can count on me for backup.\c
Till then, see you around,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
